nodes.hint: FEM runs are heavy; for regular work connect your own server
nodes.hintTip: Your own server runs your jobs with the same solver version. It connects out over HTTPS, so there are no ports to open, and its CPU time does not count against fair use.

share.label: Share idle time with MOTRES
share.tip: Off by default. When on, MOTRES may run its own jobs on this node while you have nothing queued: only MOTRES catalog work (for example passport computations of catalog motors) that an admin marked shareable, signed and version-pinned like your own jobs. Never the job of another customer, never confidential or NDA data. Shared jobs run at the lowest priority (nice 19, idle IO) within the core and RAM caps below. Your own jobs always go first: a shared job stops within seconds when you submit one, and is re-queued, not failed.
share.capsTip: Default: half of the cores and half of the RAM.
share.stopTip: Turns sharing off and ends the MOTRES job running on this node within seconds; the job is re-queued elsewhere.
